inputs.text: [excited] YOO… tah… RAP… tor. "Utah" is the American state where its bones were found. And "raptor," in Latin, [curious] is thief. So what does that give us?
[happily] There you go. [proud] It lived right there, in North America, one hundred twenty-six million years ago.
[gasps] Is it a cousin of Velociraptor?
[proud] Yes, but a much bigger cousin. [amazed] It's the biggest raptor we know of.
